tool.title: List pull requests (GitHub)
tool.description: List the open pull requests of the current checkout's GitHub project, optionally only those from one branch.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.description: Only proposals whose source branch is this.

outputs.name: proposals
outputs.description: One line per open change proposal: number, title, source branch.

selection.when: The change proposals live on GitHub — the checkout's remote is a GitHub project.
selection.limits: GitHub only. For a GitLab project use `gitlab-mr-list`.
selection.cost: `gh`, authenticated (`gh auth login` or `GH_TOKEN`), and one API round trip per call.

remedies.none: No declared Tool reaches the GitHub API another way. A session that provides the GitHub MCP server can use it instead.
